subject: My favorite HubSpot reporting “loophole”
snippet:
When HubSpot doesn’t support the report I need, I built a live report in Sheets, then embed it directly inside of my HubSpot dashboard.
 
 Hey Zain,
 
 As a fellow HubSpot user, I’ve hit more than a few reporting roadblocks inside HubSpot.
